title: Knobby Briny Portuguese Pork Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Portuguese stew featuring pork shoulder steaks, perfect for a sick day. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly dish is cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, carrots, briny green olives, chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then add the browned pork back to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
